experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion under liquidity friction and order flow imbalance
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD hourly price deviations exceeding 3% of VWAP are statistically likely to revert within 30 hours due to liquidity friction and order flow imbalance, despite apparent intraday momentum signals.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion with a 3% threshold over a 30-hour lookback fails to show statistically significant price reversion (p > 0.05 in a t-test of price deviation vs. VWAP) across at least 100 consecutive hours of data, then the hypothesis is falsified.
